papers.summary: Explainable survival-risk assessment for advanced heart failure with renal dysfunction, integrating multicenter clinical data, survival machine learning and external validation.
A machine-learning and transcriptomic framework for quantifying atherosclerotic plaque vulnerability using bulk and single-cell data.
An integrative single-cell and bulk-transcriptomic study of vascular smooth muscle cell fate decisions and molecular heterogeneity in atherosclerosis.
A machine-learning post-translational-modification signature for lung adenocarcinoma prognosis and immunotherapy stratification, identifying B4GALT2 as an immune-exclusion-associated regulator.
A preclinical cardio-oncology study testing NLRP3 inflammasome inhibition in immune-checkpoint-inhibitor cardiotoxicity.
Plasma Olink proteomics for biomarker discovery and diagnosis in dilated cardiomyopathy with heart failure.
A multidimensional-omics review linking tumor immune microenvironment biology to next-generation CAR-T strategies and precision immunotherapy.
A computational study of circadian rhythm disruption in coronary atherosclerotic disease using transcriptomic and single-cell data, including a circadian rhythm disruption score.
A review of immunogenic cell death as a strategy to enhance CAR-T and cancer immunotherapy, including multiple regulated cell-death programs.
A mechanistic study linking idebenone-mediated cardioprotection after myocardial infarction to ROS, autophagy, ferroptosis and AMPK–mTOR signaling.
